recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,291.10 (+0.58%) and the Sensex at 81,904.45 (+0.38%); Bank Nifty moved +0.89%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +0.38%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.40%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.95%.
FMCG led the sectors (+1.87%), while Metal lagged (-1.55%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Belrise Industries (+9.29%); biggest faller was Kaynes Technology India (-13.12%). Breadth: 173 advances vs 327 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.40% and the Nasdaq down 0.91%.
The rupee is at 93.91 per dollar, Brent at $92.58 (-3.40%) and gold at $3,858 (-0.74%).
